content.short: Nouns DAO auctions one Noun NFT every day, forever, and the Noun holders decide how the ETH raised is spent.
content.description: Every day a new pixel-art Noun is generated and auctioned, and every ETH raised is sent to the DAO's treasury. Each Noun gives its owner one vote on how that treasury is used, which over the years has funded grants, public goods, films, parade floats and crypto infrastructure. The artwork is stored fully onchain and released into the public domain, so anyone can use it. Its treasury holds thousands of ETH, and proposals have funded everything from naming a frog to a Rose Parade float and a school in Uganda. It is governed through a Compound Governance fork and the Nouns DUNA legal entity in Wyoming.
content.meta: Daily onchain NFT auctions funding a treasury that Noun holders govern, with public domain art. Explore Nouns DAO on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
